steps.text: what is a mutex? and how does that turn into a deadlock?

A mutex lets one operation use a shared resource at a time. A deadlock can happen when operations wait on each other and none can continue. Adding a lock does not automatically fix the underlying bug.

def deliver_with_retry(payload)
  attempts = 0
  begin
    deliver_webhook(payload)
  rescue DeliveryFailed
    attempts += 1
    raise if attempts >= 5
    sleep(2 ** attempts)
    retry
  end
end
